description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to assertion control within the Thunder namespace, including singleton management, assertion event handling, and category type definitions.

classes.name: AssertionUnitProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing assertion units, singleton pattern, handling assertion events and handlers.

classes.name: BaseAssertType
classes.description: Represents a category type for assertions, providing static access to assertion control and metadata.

classes.name: AssertionControl
classes.description: Inner class managing the enable/disable state of assertion categories, implementing IControl interface.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AssertionControl.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the assertion category.
